contracts: CPU engines/defaults and existing GPU runtime files unchanged; diagnostics are opt-in and separate from sampler/prior logic

Spectral reference is a serial CPU callback using fresh physical state and original coverage; never labelled GPU computation or speedup
Fixed spectral response snapshots detect changed sampled responses; no global CPU monkeypatch or physical cache across candidates
